rule: A row gets ok only from a current listing, its own site or recent reviews with nothing saying closed (docs/EATS.md). A row is taken out when a search could not find the place at all or the sources disagree; a place found but not freshly confirmed stays without ok.
scope: the four rows without ok; the twenty-three rows already confirmed were not checked again
how: Google Maps opened in headless Chromium (2026-11-23), limited view without a reviews tab, so no review date could be read; a place with current hours and no closed notice counts as a current listing. One web search for the Imperial resort's restaurant

confirmed.name: Khao Kho Talay Phu
confirmed.src: https://www.google.com/maps/search/เขาค้อทะเลภู
confirmed.page_name: เขาค้อทะเลภู
confirmed.evidence: Google Maps: listed as a restaurant, 4.2★, 75 Moo 2, Thung Samo, Khao Kho; 'Open · Closes 8 PM'; nothing says closed. Map query now names it and its address

confirmed.name: Imperial Phukaew Hill Resort restaurant
confirmed.evidence: Google Maps: 3-star hotel, 4.1★, 99 Phitsanulok–Lom Sak Rd, Khaem Son, Khao Kho (Q2M6+M2), rooms on sale for 26–27 Nov 2026; booking listings (Expedia, Hotels.com) say 'There's a restaurant on site, as well as a coffee shop/cafe' and a daily buffet breakfast; nothing says closed. The restaurant has no listing of its own: the ok rests on the resort being open and listed with a restaurant
